model.description: BUG: in /trace, expanding a Bug-type chain node shows NO children. The chain (req→uc→class→method→impl→test) exists but doesn't render because the FORWARD_KEYS resolver has no entry for ior:class:Bug. It resolves Requirement→useCases but not Bug→useCases (Bug extends Requirement per R20.4 but the resolver doesn't inherit). FIX: add Bug (and ChangeRequest) to the FORWARD_KEYS map with the same forward keys as Requirement (useCases[], tasks[]). Tron evidence: IMG_4038.
